column1: # Escrita syllable fixture, English: word<TAB>syllable count.

# Source: the syllable counts of a standard American dictionary (Merriam-Webster style) applied by hand. Words the dictionaries count differently (fire, hour, flower, every, family, camera, different, comfortable, chocolate, real) were left out rather than guessed.

# Mix: silent final e, -le endings, -ed and -es endings, vowel pairs that split (ia io eo ua uo, quiet, science), vowel pairs that do not, irregular words, compounds, and longer words up to 6 syllables.
# Awaiting the author's dictionary check (gate G3).
# Rows are frozen (docs/PLAN-0.5.md, Ownership rules): later tasks may add rows, never change or delete one. A row that looks wrong goes to the author (gate G3).
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are comments.
